verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Caveman publishes an llms.txt at docs.caveman.so (HTTP 200), described as documentation for Caveman and Caveman Cloud. A machine-readable openapi.json is also served, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the .md probe returned 404), first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Documentation for Caveman and Caveman Cloud.
